value.rationale: Quantifies exactly the interaction between maximally diameter-two geometry and atomic concentration in an outer p-sum. Collapses an infinite-dimensional infimum over all slices to only the Daugavet norm, total atomic mass and maximal atom, with no dependence on the number of atoms. The sharp p=2 phase boundary M=1/2 and a five-equal-atom strictly interior optimal slice reveal a nontrivial competition absent from the already-known outer p=1 and scalar-summand cases. These data directly answer how atom dispersal affects a natural quantitative pointwise invariant.
